description: Issuer-reviewed mapping of depreciation/amortisation cash-flow lines that the issuer tagged with extension concepts. Each entry was checked against the pinned filing's consolidated cash-flow statement (label, amount, tag). The listed concepts are summed; impairment lines are never included. Never applied to issuers not listed here.

issuers.note: Cash-flow statement lines 871 and 781 (EUR m, FY2025; FY2024 822 and 716). 'Depreciations des actifs non courants' (53) is an impairment line and is excluded. Operating result 6,699 on the income statement; derived EBITDA = 8,351 EUR m.

Income statement 'Depreciation and impairments' 18.6 (EUR m, FY2025; FY2024 18.7). Notes 12-14 show only 'Depreciation' movements: PP&E incl. right-of-use 15.8 + intangibles 2.9 = 18.7 (rounding), goodwill accumulated impairment unchanged at 0.4, no impairment line in any roll-forward; cash flow note 25 repeats 18.6. Line is therefore depreciation/amortisation in FY2025. Operating profit 64.5, derived EBITDA = 83.1 EUR m. Valid for periodEnd only.
